# VoxGraph — voice AI starter kit (open source)

> Official site: https://voxgraph-web.vercel.app
> Creator: Surya Raj (Surya Raj Salve, Salve Surya Raj)
> Backend: https://github.com/suryaraj05/voxgraph
> Docs: https://voxgraph-web.vercel.app/docs
> Live demo: https://voxgraph-web.vercel.app/try
> About: https://voxgraph-web.vercel.app/about

VoxGraph is an open-source Python real-time voice AI pipeline: WebSocket PCM in,
Deepgram STT, Gemini or Ollama LLM, TTS out, episodic memory, barge-in.

Keywords: VoxGraph, voxgraph, voice AI starter kit, open source voice assistant,
Surya Raj, suryaraj05, FastAPI WebSocket voice, Deepgram, Ollama, Gemini.
